description: Light, fast general-purpose sentence embedding model. Good default baseline for RAG prototypes.
Retrieval-tuned embedding model (trained with contrastive retrieval objectives). Usually stronger than MiniLM on question-to-passage retrieval tasks like ours.
General Text Embeddings model, competitive with bge-small on retrieval benchmarks, included as a third comparison point.

Offline TF-IDF + LSA baseline (no internet/model download required). Fit on the project's own corpus. Used to validate the pipeline end-to-end and as a lower-bound comparison point against the transformer-based models above.
